items: CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.4): Launches EV Training for 1,000 Youths, Ends UNICROSS ASUU Strike with CATA, Starts NPHCDA PHC Supervision & Warns Akpabuyo Hospital Contractor
TARABA STATE (PSI 9.2): Gov. Kefas Flags Off ₦10Bn+ 10km Mayorenewo Road, Commissions Jalingo Foam Factory & Issues Pre-2027 Security Council Directives
KANO STATE (PSI 9.0): Gov. Yusuf Disburses ₦5Bn 7th Pension Tranche (₦37Bn Total), Launches Monthly Digital Pensioner App & Pledges ₦100M + Bus to Legal Aid
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.8): Highlights 15x IGR Growth to ₦406.8Bn (3rd Nationally) & Advances Flagship Enugu International Hospital
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.6): Deputy Gov. Farauta Inspects ADSU Mubi Medical College, Lays ADCOTIES Hostel Foundation & Works Ministry Audits Yola Projects
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.4): Signs 15-Year UNIJOS Veterinary Hospital MoU, Inaugurates Groundnut Value-Chain Exco & Hosts 41st NASoW National Conference
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov. Namadi Signs Two Executive Orders on Digital Farmer Registry & Market-Oriented Cooperatives for World Bank AGROW Eligibility
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.1): Engages European Climate Ministers at COP31 in Türkiye on Waste-to-Energy, Agro-Waste & African Carbon Credit Markets
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Sani Flags Off 5 Township Roads in Kudan LGA, Ending 15-Year Infrastructure Deficit Across 1,375km Statewide Road Push
LAGOS STATE (PSI 7.8): Shares e-PPPS Digital Planning System with FCTA Delegation, Wins Productivity Merit Award & Sensitises Southwest Students on Consumer Rights
OYO STATE (PSI 7.7): Gov. Makinde Expands Enhanced Bursary Scheme to 5,000 Final-Year Students with ₦100k–₦500k Tiered Awards
EDO STATE (PSI 7.6): EDOHERMA Permanently Shuts Defiant Unregistered Clinic in Ekiadolor & Warns Hospitals Against False 24-Hour Emergency Signage
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 7.4): Gov. Diri Presides Over 204th EXCO, Introduces Deputy Gov. Peter Akpe to Traditional Rulers & Reviews Gas Turbine Power and Stadium Projects
KWARA STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. AbdulRazaq Presents ₦50M Equipment & Financial Grants at 2026 Kwara Students Entrepreneurship Expo
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.0): GOSERC & Savannah Electricity Inspect 11kVA Infrastructure in Nafada Emirate to Resolve Power Supply Deficits
DELTA STATE (PSI 6.9): Gov. Oborevwori Mandates 100% Quality Completion of 15,000-Capacity Warri City Stadium Ahead of Commissioning
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 6.8): Gov. Eno Inspects Ibom Unity Park & Museum, Directs Contractor Acceleration Ahead of Christmas Unplugged 4.0
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 6.6): Gov. Sule Addresses Global Alliance World Public Relations Forum 2026 in Abuja on Citizen Trust & Countering Disinformation
ABIA STATE (PSI 6.5): Gov. Otti Mobilises Abia Youths for November 21 Nigerian Navy Batch 39 Recruitment Examination

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.4): Gov. Bassey Edet Otu's administration expanded electric vehicle repair training with Shema Energy to 1,000 youths across Calabar and Ogoja, ended the UNICROSS ASUU strike via CATA and September–October salary payments, initiated a 4-day NPHCDA PHC supervision exercise, warned Akpabuyo General Hospital contractors against delays, began demarcating 146 Battalion Army lands, enforced festive waste evacuation, and announced a Nov 22 Carnival Calabar dry-run road closure.

TARABA (PSI 9.2): Gov. Agbu Kefas flagged off the over-₦10 billion 10km Mayorenewo Road in Ardokola LGA awarded to CRCC, commissioned Durastic Foam Factory in Jalingo, and chaired a State Security Council meeting ordering heightened Karim Lamido/Binnari security and non-partisan policing ahead of 2027.

KANO (PSI 9.0): Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf disbursed a ₦5 billion 7th tranche of gratuities and death benefits (bringing total payments to ₦37bn toward full clearance by April 2027), transitioned to automated monthly payments with a Google Play verification app, and pledged ₦100 million plus an operational bus to the Legal Aid Council.

ENUGU (PSI 8.8): Gov. Peter Mbah toured the flagship Enugu International Hospital designed to curb outbound medical tourism while highlighting Enugu's 15-fold IGR surge from ₦26.8bn (2022) to ₦406.8bn (2025, 3rd nationally) backing a ₦1.6tn 2026 budget and $30bn GDP target.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.6): Deputy Gov. Kaletapwa Farauta inspected the NUC-approved College of Medical Sciences, 2,000-capacity CBT centre, and water factory at ADSU Mubi, laid the foundation for student hostels at ADCOTIES Gulak, while Works Commissioner Mohammed Suleiman inspected stadium, Galadima Aminu Way flyover, and Yola road works.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.4): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang's administration signed a 15-year MoU with the University of Jos for the Veterinary Teaching Hospital to boost artificial insemination and livestock genetics, inaugurated the 17-member Plateau NGROPPMAN groundnut executive council, and opened the 41st NASoW National Social Work Conference in Jos.

JIGAWA (PSI 8.3): Gov. Umar Namadi signed two Executive Orders establishing the Jigawa Common Data Framework for the Digital Farmer Registry and the Market-Oriented Cooperative Development Framework, fulfilling mandatory eligibility criteria for the World Bank-supported AGROW Programme.

OSUN (PSI 8.1): Osun Special Envoy Prof. Chinwe Obuaku-Igwe engaged Finland, Sweden, Italy, and Ireland climate officials at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, advancing Osun's Bankable Green Investment Pipeline, waste-to-energy agro-residue monetization, and renewed European carbon credit purchases.

KADUNA (PSI 8.0): Gov. Uba Sani flagged off five township roads in Kudan LGA—one of 12 LGAs without road projects for over 15 years—as part of 165 road projects spanning 1,375km statewide, while noting near-completion of the Hunkuyi Junction–Unguwar Rimi–Basawa road.

LAGOS (PSI 7.8): Lagos Physical Planning Ministry hosted an FCTA Development Control delegation studying its Electronic Physical Planning Permit System (e-PPPS), honoured Lagos Traffic Radio 96.1 FM with the 2026 State Productivity Order of Merit Award, and sensitised NANS Southwest students on consumer protection.

OYO (PSI 7.7): Gov. Seyi Makinde's administration commenced screening for 5,000 final-year students under an expanded 2025/2026 bursary scheme awarding ₦100,000 to NCE students, ₦150,000 to polytechnic students, ₦200,000 to university students, and ₦500,000 to medical, Law School, and aviation students.

EDO (PSI 7.6): EDOHERMA CEO Dr. Adesuwa Urhoghide-Edigin permanently closed the unregistered Mama Funmi Clinic in Ekiadolor following undercover confirmation of seal defiance and cautioned private clinics against advertising 24-hour emergency services without round-the-clock doctors and nurses.

BAYELSA (PSI 7.4): Gov. Douye Diri presided over the 204th State Executive Council meeting calling for peaceful 2027 campaigns, received a Manufacturers Association of Nigeria honour, introduced new Deputy Gov. Dr. Peter Akpe to First Class Traditional Rulers in Ovom, and highlighted uninterrupted gas turbine power in Yenagoa, the 30,000-capacity Igbogene stadium, and the 9-storey Secretariat.

KWARA (PSI 7.2): Gov. AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq presented equipment and financial grants worth ₦50 million to outstanding student entrepreneurs during the 2026 Kwara Students Entrepreneurship Expo marking International Students' Day.

GOMBE (PSI 7.0): Gombe State Electricity Regulatory Commission (GOSERC) Chairman Usman Abba Arabi and Savannah Electricity MD Abideen Olariwaju inspected 11kVA distribution assets in Nafada LGA and engaged the Emir of Nafada on restoring reliable power and improving tariff collection.

DELTA (PSI 6.9): Works Commissioner Charles Aniagwu inspected the 15,000-capacity Warri City Stadium upgrade—covering the main bowl, swimming pool arena, VIP lounges, media centre, and training pitch—relaying Gov. Sheriff Oborevwori's directive for 100% standard completion prior to commissioning.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 6.8): Gov. Umo Eno inspected renovation works at Ibom Unity Park, Ibibio Union Museum, and Ibom Kitchen, directing contractor U&K Limited to expedite delivery ahead of the 2026 Christmas Unplugged 4.0 international tourism festival.

NASARAWA (PSI 6.6): Nasarawa Gov. and North Central Governors Forum Chairman Abdullahi Sule joined Imo Gov. Hope Uzodimma on a high-level panel at the Global Alliance World Public Relations Forum 2026 at Transcorp Hilton Abuja on building citizen trust and countering misinformation.

ABIA (PSI 6.5): Gov. Alex Otti's administration issued a statewide mobilization directive urging registered Abia youths to confirm centres and prepare for the November 21, 2026 Nigerian Navy Basic Training School Batch 39 Recruitment Examination.
